paper.title: Large Language Monkeys : Scaling Inference Compute with Repeated Sampling

result.summary: 本文探索将推理阶段的计算量作为新的扩展维度，采用重复采样（repeated sampling）这一简单技术，从模型中反复采样候选解 [S1.p3]。在多个任务和模型上，覆盖率（coverage）随样本数在四个数量级范围内扩展，且覆盖率与样本数的关系常呈对数线性，可用指数幂律建模 [abstract]。在编码和形式化证明等可自动验证的领域，覆盖率的提升直接转化为性能提升；例如在 SWE-bench Lite 上，DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 的解决率从单样本的 15.9% 提升到 250 个样本的 56%，超过单样本最优的 43% [abstract]。而在没有自动验证器的领域，多数投票和奖励模型等常见选择方法在数百个样本后趋于平台期，无法随样本预算充分扩展 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文关注的问题是：在推理阶段，用户和开发者通常限制模型只做一次尝试，而训练计算量的扩展已被证明能持续提升模型能力 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。作者希望系统性地刻画重复采样在多种任务、模型和样本预算下带来的收益 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Scaling the amount of training compute through bigger models, longer pre-training runs, and larger datasets has been a consistent driver of these gains.
However, when interacting with LLMs, users and developers often restrict models to making only one attempt when solving a problem.
Our goal is to systematically characterize these benefits across a range of tasks, models, and sample budgets.

method.text: 论文采用重复采样（repeated sampling）作为扩展推理计算量的简单方法，即从模型中独立生成多个候选解 [S1.p3]。在 SWE-bench Lite 上，作者使用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 并配备开源 Moatless Tools 库作为软件框架，一次尝试指一整段多轮轨迹，每个问题限制 250 次独立尝试 [S2.SS1.p1]。采样使用标准温度采样，温度设为 1.6 [A2.SS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: In this work, we explore repeated sampling (Figure 1) as a simple approach to scaling inference compute in order to improve reasoning performance.
For SWE-bench Lite, we use DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct, as the required context length of this task exceeds the limits of the Llama-3 models.
In our work, we use the open-source Moatless Tools library.
One sample/attempt for this benchmark refers to one entire multi-turn trajectory.
To minimize costs, we restrict the number of attempts per issue to 250, with all attempts made independently of one another.
With this setup, we sample 250 independent completions for each problem using standard temperature-based sampling.
Based on these results, we selected a temperature of 1.6 for our main experiments.

experiments.text: 论文在多个数据集上评估：GSM8K（随机选取 128 道测试题）、MATH（128 道随机测试题）、MiniF2F-MATH（使用 Lean4，评估 130 道由 MATH 形式化的测试题）、CodeContests（要求用 Python3 编写解答）以及 SWE-bench Lite（真实 GitHub 问题，需编辑代码库，用单元测试自动检查）[S2.p4]。在 CodeContests、MiniF2F、GSM8K 和 MATH 上，使用 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3-70B-Instruct，每个问题生成 10,000 个独立样本 [S2.SS1.p1]。在 SWE-bench Lite 上使用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct，每个问题限制 250 次尝试 [S2.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: GSM8K: A dataset of grade-school level math word problems. We evaluate on a random subset of 128 problems from the GSM8K test set.
MATH: Another dataset of math word problems that are generally harder than those from GSM8K. Similarly, we evaluate on 128 random problems from this dataset’s test set.

MiniF2F-MATH: A dataset of mathematics problems that have been formalized into proof checking languages. We use Lean4 as our language, and evaluate on the 130 test set problems that are formalized from the MATH dataset.

CodeContests: A dataset of competitive programming problems. Each problem has a text description, along with a set of input-output test cases (hidden from the model) that can be used to verify the correctness of a candidate solution. We enforce that models write their solutions using Python3.
SWE-bench Lite: A dataset of real world Github issues, where each problem consists of a description and a snapshot of a code repository.
We evaluate Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-70B-Instruct on CodeContests, MiniF2F, GSM8K, and MATH, generating 10,000 independent samples per problem.
For SWE-bench Lite, we use DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct, as the required context length of this task exceeds the limits of the Llama-3 models.

findings.text: 重复采样在多种任务和模型上大幅提升覆盖率，使弱模型通过大量样本有可能超越更强模型的单次采样 [S1.p12]。覆盖率与样本数的关系常可用指数幂律建模，暗示存在推理时扩展规律 [S1.p12]。在 SWE-bench Lite 上，DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 的解决率从单样本的 15.9% 提升到 250 个样本的 56%，超过单样本最优的 43% [abstract]。在没有自动验证器的领域，常见验证方法在约 100 个样本后趋于平台期，与覆盖率上界之间的差距不断扩大 [S1.p12]。

evidence.quote: We demonstrate that scaling inference compute through repeated sampling leads to large improvements in coverage across a variety of tasks and models.
This makes it possible, and sometimes cost-effective, to amplify weaker models with many samples and outperform single samples from more capable models.
We show that the relationship between coverage and the number of samples can often be modelled using an exponentiated power law, suggesting a form of scaling laws for inference-time compute.
In domains without automatic verifiers, we show that common approaches to verification plateau beyond approximately 100 samples.
This leads to a growing gap between the performance achieved with these methods and the coverage upper bound.
the fraction of issues solved with DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct increases from 15.9% with one sample to 56% with 250 samples, outperforming the single-sample state-of-the-art of 43%.

limitations.text: 作者指出，在没有自动验证工具时，改进样本验证方法很重要，让模型能评估自身输出将使重复采样扩展到更多任务 [S5.p5]。作者特别提到将重复采样应用于创意写作等非结构化任务，这类任务可能需要比本文所考虑的对错任务更主观的样本比较 [S5.p5]。此外，软件开发任务中单元测试等工具采用黑盒方式验证代码，不如证明检查器全面，这些验证过程的不完善可能导致假阳性和/或假阴性 [S4.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our results from Section 4 highlight the importance of improving sample verification methods when tools for automatically doing so are unavailable.
Equipping models with the ability to assess their own outputs will allow repeated sampling to be scaled to far more tasks.

Of particular interest is applying repeated sampling to unstructured tasks like creative writing, which can require a more subjective comparison between different samples than the pass-fail tasks we consider.
However, tools like unit tests take a black-box approach to verifying a piece of code and are not as comprehensive as methods like proof checkers.
These imperfections in the verification process can lead to false positives and/or false negatives that are important to consider when applying repeated sampling.
